Interface JabaController

All Known Implementing Classes:
JabaWizard
public interface JabaController
Interface for the JABA wizard controller, accessible from jmt-jaba-gui panels without a compile-time dependency on jaba.JabaController (which lives in jmt-jsimg-gui).
